name: Expiring certificates (Windows)
description: Lists certificates in a LocalMachine store that are expired or expire within a number of days.

params.name: days
params.label: Days ahead
params.description: Report certificates expiring within this many days (expired ones are always included).

output: Count and table of expired or expiring certificates (status, days left, subject, thumbprint). Exit 0; exit 2 on invalid parameters.
